item.text: Перехожу к проверке: сначала прогоню CLI на валидных и ошибочных входах, включая ничьи критического пути, циклы и нулевые длительности.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'set -eu
TEST_DIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/dependency-planner-test.XXXXXX)
trap '"'rm -rf \""'$TEST_DIR"'"' EXIT
run_ok() {
  name="'$1
  json=$2
  expected=$3
  input="$TEST_DIR/$name.json"
  command printf '"'%s' \""'$json" > "$input"
  actual=$(bun run src/cli.ts plan "$input")
  if [ "$actual" != "$expected" ]; then
    command printf '"'FAIL %s\\nexpected: %s\\nactual:   %s\\n' \""'$name" "$expected" "$actual"
    exit 1
  fi
  command printf '"'PASS %s\\n' \""'$name"
}
run_fail() {
  name=$1
  json=$2
  needle=$3
  input="$TEST_DIR/$name.json"
  err="$TEST_DIR/$name.err"
  command printf '"'%s' \""'$json" > "$input"
  if bun run src/cli.ts plan "$input" > /dev/null 2> "$err"; then
    command printf '"'FAIL %s: unexpectedly succeeded\\n' \""'$name"
    exit 1
  fi
  if ! grep -F "$needle" "$err" > /dev/null; then
    command printf '"'FAIL %s: missing diagnostic %s\\n' \""'$name" "$needle"
    command sed -n '"'1,20p' \""'$err"
    exit 1
  fi
  command printf '"'PASS %s\\n' \""'$name"
}
run_ok empty '"'{\"tasks\":[]}' '{\"order\":[],\"layers\":[],\"earliest\":{},\"totalDuration\":0,\"criticalPath\":[]}'
run_ok basic '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"build\",\"duration\":3,\"dependsOn\":[\"lint\"]},{\"id\":\"lint\",\"duration\":2},{\"id\":\"test\",\"duration\":4,\"dependsOn\":[\"lint\"]}]}' '{\"order\":[\"lint\",\"build\",\"test\"],\"layers\":[[\"lint\"],[\"build\",\"test\"]],\"earliest\":{\"lint\":{\"start\":0,\"finish\":2},\"build\":{\"start\":2,\"finish\":5},\"test\":{\"start\":2,\"finish\":6}},\"totalDuration\":6,\"criticalPath\":[\"lint\",\"test\"]}'
run_ok tie '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"z\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"a\",\"b\"]},{\"id\":\"b\",\"duration\":2},{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":2}]}' '{\"order\":[\"a\",\"b\",\"z\"],\"layers\":[[\"a\",\"b\"],[\"z\"]],\"earliest\":{\"a\":{\"start\":0,\"finish\":2},\"b\":{\"start\":0,\"finish\":2},\"z\":{\"start\":2,\"finish\":3}},\"totalDuration\":3,\"criticalPath\":[\"a\",\"z\"]}'
run_ok zero '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"c\",\"duration\":0,\"dependsOn\":[\"b\"]},{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":0},{\"id\":\"b\",\"duration\":0,\"dependsOn\":[\"a\"]},{\"id\":\"d\",\"duration\":0}]}' '{\"order\":[\"a\",\"b\",\"c\",\"d\"],\"layers\":[[\"a\",\"d\"],[\"b\"],[\"c\"]],\"earliest\":{\"a\":{\"start\":0,\"finish\":0},\"b\":{\"start\":0,\"finish\":0},\"c\":{\"start\":0,\"finish\":0},\"d\":{\"start\":0,\"finish\":0}},\"totalDuration\":0,\"criticalPath\":[\"a\",\"b\",\"c\"]}'
run_fail cycle '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"b\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"a\"]},{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"b\"]}]}' 'a -> b -> a'
run_fail unknown_dep '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"missing\"]}]}' 'unknown id'
run_fail duplicate_dep '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":1},{\"id\":\"b\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"a\",\"a\"]}]}' 'duplicate id'
run_fail invalid_json '{' 'invalid JSON'
if bun run src/cli.ts nope \""'$TEST_DIR/empty.json" > /dev/null 2> "$TEST_DIR/cmd.err"; then
  command printf '"'FAIL unknown command\\n'
  exit 1
fi
grep -F 'unknown command' \""'$TEST_DIR/cmd.err" > /dev/null
command printf '"'PASS unknown_command\\n'
if bun run src/cli.ts plan \""'$TEST_DIR/empty.json" --wat > /dev/null 2> "$TEST_DIR/flag.err"; then
  command printf '"'FAIL unknown flag\\n'
  exit 1
fi
grep -F 'unknown flag' \""'$TEST_DIR/flag.err" > /dev/null
command printf '"'PASS unknown_flag\\n'
command printf 'ALL SELF-TESTS PASSED\\n'"
